findings.effect: Even with flag true and percentage100, completed baseline conversations never automatically enter V2; a completed V2 sample shows the new composition is deployed for admitted conversations.
Strict foreground fallback remains gpt-oss-120b on cerebras/fp16; recent runtime logs record Groq provider error then Cerebras success.

Observed baseline requests contain 33 messages, 30 projected history messages and a 17453-byte structured schema. Native OpenRouter metadata confirms 8121/8912/8117 input tokens; byte sizes are not tokenizer measurements.

V2 constructor supplies continuation/write policy but no maxInputTokens or tokenizer. AgentLoop defaults maxTotalTokens/maxInputTokens to32000 with serialized-byte conservative reservation. The1800-token target remains unimplemented, not a certified hard ceiling.

Handled V2 usage is not returned or logged here; typed AIResponse omits generation/provider identity. The diagnosed generation IDs come from baseline logs, so this inspection does not measure the recent V2 call tokens.
